serverInfo.name: Arsenal Decision Engine
serverInfo.description: Stateless R_net evaluation middleware for autonomous DeFAI agents. Computes Impermanent Loss, net yield, and Breakeven Corridor in O(1). Protected by L402 Lightning paywall.

authentication.description: Lightning Network micro-payment. First 3 requests/hour free. 50 sats (LOW/MODERATE risk) or 500 sats (HIGH/CRITICAL risk) per evaluation.

tools.name: evaluate_pool
tools.description: Evaluates a concentrated liquidity LP position risk. Computes R_net (net yield after IL), Breakeven Corridor bounds, and risk level (LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL). O(1) algebraic — no LLM, no hallucination.

apy.description: Annualized Percentage Yield of the pool (e.g. 0.20 for 20%).

price_ratio.description: Current price / entry price ratio (e.g. 0.85 means price dropped 15%).

days_held.description: Number of days the position has been held.

r_net_pct.description: Net return after IL. Positive = profitable.
